Name: (CP) Buildable Large Trees Pack
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][color=#ff0000][size=6]Notes![/size][/color]
[size=4]If you install this mod with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14552]SF version[/url]﻿﻿ of the old mod, unexpected problems may occur, so please be sure to delete the SF version﻿ files when installing this mod![/size][/quote]
If you become friends with Robin, he will be willing to transplant trees to your farm.

The wild trees and city trees have been changed to 2x1, although the construction tiles were originally 2x2.
This is not a bug, but a change for convenience.

Various settings can be changed from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url] settings.

English and Japanese are supported.

The graphic trees in the other mods...
"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿" (Created byAzrashar / Uploaded by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/73472878]dugongkebalik[/url])
"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]" (Created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url])
